en.headline: Discovery Bay stages fourth open-water swim challenge today
en.dek: Solo races of 400 metres, 1.7 kilometres and 3.8 kilometres, plus a 400-metre relay, finish at Tai Pak Beach on Sunday.
body: The fourth Discovery Bay Open Water Race Challenge is being held on Sunday, organised by Open Water Swim Series Hong Kong and title-sponsored by Discovery Bay.

The programme is open to swimmers of different ages and includes 3.8-kilometre, 1.7-kilometre and 400-metre solo races, as well as a 400-metre relay. Starting points are set at Tai Pak Beach, San Pak Wan or the Disneyland Resort Pier, and all races finish at Tai Pak Beach.
Discovery Bay's operator said the event forms part of a wider summer sports programme at the resort. Race-day arrangements are handled by the organiser, Open Water Swim Series Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 第四屆愉景灣公開水域泳賽今日舉行
zh.dek: 公開組設400米、1.7公里及3.8公里個人賽，另有400米接力，終點同為大白灣泳灘。
body: 第四屆愉景灣公開水域泳賽於周日舉行，由香港公開水域泳賽系列主辦，愉景灣冠名贊助。
賽事開放不同年齡泳手參加，項目包括3.8公里、1.7公里及400米個人賽，以及400米接力。起點設於大白灣泳灘、舸舢灣或迪士尼碼頭，各項賽事終點均為大白灣泳灘。
愉景灣營運方表示，活動屬區內夏季體育節目之一。當日賽事安排由主辦單位香港公開水域泳賽系列負責。
